plainTranslation: Composite Jupiter in the 11 House: With Composite Jupiter in the 11th house, there can be a strong friendship between you, no matter what type of relationship/partnership it is. You can have a wide network that you develop together, personally or professionally, and you can have a larger impact on the world together than you can apart. You can 61/ ​© The Dark Pixie Astrology embrace what’s different about one another, and you may be more experimental together, open to trying things that are unconventional.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
